scope: Read-only public-source snapshot and sanitized technical acceptance summary. No private credentials or raw phone/chat material were supplied. No device operation or tests were performed by the reviewer. This was a focused review, not a complete security certification.

confirmed_finding.trigger: The phone is connected and Android requires SIM verification, while UI text only mentions device password/biometrics.
confirmed_finding.impact: The owner can be directed toward the wrong type of verification.
confirmed_finding.fix: Name phone unlock or SIM verification in the main UI, related accessibility description and background explanation; retain current authentication behavior.

parent_verification.method: git diff of the complete apps/android trees is empty

unresolved_validation: An offline second test phone has no available diagnostic entry; cause unknown.
The second personal AI lacks a verified persistent private identity in its current environment; code61 handoff has not run.
SIM PIN protection remains enabled on the active phone; a previous owner verification does not disable it.
Combined device credentials plus SIM PIN and multi-day unattended use remain unverified.

process_exit_reason_review.finding: The review raised an uncertainty about REASON_USER_STOPPED. Official documentation identifies this as the Android user/profile being stopped; REASON_USER_REQUESTED covers a user force-stopping or removing an app. No evidence established a missing ordinary-app stop barrier, so no speculative change was made.

release_scope: Existing evidence supports the stated limited Beta, not complete migration or a promise of zero owner participation.
